faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the Sen PvZ2 modding tool.
faq.q1: Do I need coding knowledge to use Sen?
faq.a1: No! Sen is designed to be visual. You can edit maps, preview animations, and process game files using our interactive interfaces.
faq.a2: Sen runs smoothly on Windows 10/11 and Android 8.0+. You can edit and test your mods on both desktop and mobile platforms.
faq.a3: Sen is actively updated. If you encounter issues or need help, join our Discord server or create an issue report on GitHub.
faq.q4: How do I import assets or map resources?
faq.a4: You can download full map asset packs from our Resources tab and link them directly in Sen's settings menu.

overview.title: Project Overview
overview.p1: Sen is a visual editor and utility suite built to streamline the customization of Plants vs. Zombies 2. It simplifies the modding process by replacing manual file editing with structured visual controls.
overview.p2: Whether you are designing maps, viewing animations, or processing game files, Sen provides a centralized environment to handle your workflow.
